changelog:
- Improved onboarding: new users now receive a free nano trial (50,000 CU, 30 days) automatically on login—no purchase needed.
- Updated authentication flow: added mandatory authentication check before any CLI usage, with clearer steps for login and trial activation.
- Revised purchase flow instructions to clarify that trial quota may be sufficient for new users, and to only prompt purchase if needed.
- Expanded references to authentication documentation for more information on free trials and agent bootstrap checks.
